_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Activity filters updated time for each period and removes its token. The page's clock is fixed at 2026-11-20T12:00:00Z. The test lists exactly four conversations, copies of one: {{SEED}} (slug {{SEED_SLUG}}) updated half a day before, bulk-activity-1 three days before, bulk-activity-2 14 days before and bulk-activity-3 45 days before; their live update stream is cut off. Conversation rows are ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id='<id>']" ("the row of <id>"), and "the check" of a row is its ".drawer-selection-check" checkbox; whether a checkbox "is checked" is an eval of its .checked (polled with expect). "The visible rows" are the elements matching ".drawer .conversation-item" with "visible": true. "The status" is ".drawer-bulk-status" and "the selection count" is ".drawer-bulk-count". To "open the search at P": navigate to P, click the button "Open conversations", click the button "Search conversations...", then wait for ".drawer-search-input" to be visible. To "select the N matches": click the button "Select conversations", click the checkbox named exactly "Select all N matching conversations" (role checkbox), then check that the selection count reads exactly "N selected". Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. "The token" is [data-conversation-query-token="activity"]. "Pick the period P" means: click the button "Activity", then click the button named exactly P inside ".drawer-bulk-popover", then check that the token is visible. 1. Open the search at /c/{{SEED_SLUG}}. 2. Pick the period "Past day"; the row of {{SEED}} is visible, and the rows of bulk-activity-1, bulk-activity-2 and bulk-activity-3 are not visible (assert_not_visible). 3. Pick the period "Past week"; the rows of {{SEED}} and bulk-activity-1 are visible, and the rows of bulk-activity-2 and bulk-activity-3 are not visible. 4. Pick the period "Past month"; the rows of {{SEED}}, bulk-activity-1 and bulk-activity-2 are visible, and the row of bulk-activity-3 is not visible. 5. Pick the period "1d+"; the rows of bulk-activity-1, bulk-activity-2 and bulk-activity-3 are visible, and the row of {{SEED}} is not visible. 6. Pick the period "1w+"; the rows of bulk-activity-2 and bulk-activity-3 are visible, and the rows of {{SEED}} and bulk-activity-1 are not visible. 7. Pick the period "1mo+"; the row of bulk-activity-3 is visible, and the rows of {{SEED}}, bulk-activity-1 and bulk-activity-2 are not visible. 8. Click the button "Remove activity filter". 9. There is no token. 10. There are exactly 4 visible rows.
